title: POV: Mia Spends $180 on a Costume She Wears Once… You Spend $12 🎃

lines: Mia's Halloween costume. One hundred eighty dollars. Worn once.
scenes.img: a young woman with a ponytail in an elaborate expensive witch costume holding a long receipt, excited face, Halloween decorations, vertical composition

lines: Plus decorations. Plus candy. Plus a second outfit for the party.
scenes.img: a young woman with a ponytail carrying many shopping bags full of Halloween decorations and candy, stressed smile, vertical composition

lines: This year's average Halloween budget? About one hundred fifteen dollars.
scenes.img: a pile of Halloween pumpkins, candy and costumes next to a giant price tag with a dollar sign, vertical composition

lines: You? Costume from your own closet. Twelve dollars for one prop.
scenes.img: {HERO} dressed as a simple homemade scarecrow from old clothes with a straw hat, proud grin, vertical composition

lines: Candy? One big bag on the list. That's it.
scenes.img: {HERO} at a store holding one big bag of candy and a shopping list, calm smile, vertical composition

lines: Then November first, you go back to the store.
scenes.img: {HERO} walking into a store with a clearance sign covered in Halloween decorations, morning light, vertical composition

lines: Next year's decorations. Often half off or more.
scenes.img: {HERO} holding a pumpkin decoration with a big red discount sticker, delighted face, vertical composition

lines: Follow for one simple money move every day. Because next year, Mia pays full price again.
scenes.img: {HERO} giving a thumbs up to the viewer in a cozy living room with a carved pumpkin, vertical composition
